description: Localisation des arrêts Ilévia (bus, métro et tram) + GTFS + Pictogrammes du réseau | Ilévia is a dataset listed in Roubaix Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ilévia. Localisation des arrêts issue du fichier GTFS. Les données issues du fichier GTFS sont des données théoriques. Le fichier GTFS est régulièrement mis à jour en pièce jointe. Coverage: Roubaix. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are transports, GTFS, arrêt, station, Charte Graphique, Pictogrammes. The portal shows 4,881 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-02-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-roubaix-fr-portal.
